title: The health-review skill's hard completion gate points at a file the reset archived
note: MEASURED 2026-09-22: .claude/skills/health-review/SKILL.md names docs/claude/health-review-backlog.json in five places, including the section headed `Draining the backlog -- a HARD COMPLETION GATE (not a sample)` and the Output contract's `backlog_coverage.count_untriaged` MUST be 0. `ls docs/claude/health-review-backlog.json` -> No such file or directory; it was archived by the 2026-09-21 reset. [!] SO THE GATE IS UNSATISFIABLE AND EVERY HEALTH-REVIEW FROM THE RESET ONWARD IS EITHER INCOMPLETE BY ITS OWN CONTRACT OR QUIETLY IGNORING IT. The same file is also the skill's WINDOW anchor (`the newest backlog_drain timestamp`), so the review window has no anchor either -- this review had to open its window at the reset and say so. A binding skill at instruction-hierarchy level 5 instructing something that cannot be done is the defect class the canonical rules already record at `THIS RULE NAMED FIVE OTHER WORDS UNTIL 2026-09-12 AND NOT ONE OF THEM WAS A LEGAL status`. [!] AND THE OUTPUT TEMPLATE HAS THE SAME SHAPE OF GAP: comms/schema/health_review_response.template.json's findings status enum is `ok | watch | concern`, with NO value for `we did not look`. Under a diag outage the template FORCES an unmeasurable dimension to be rendered as a measurement outcome -- exactly the collapse docs/CLAUDE-RULES-CANONICAL.md 'Collapsed states' forbids and scripts/ci/check_collapsed_states.py enforces elsewhere. This review emitted `could_not_look` and declared the deviation rather than comply. [!] PROPOSED FIX (Tier-1): re-point the skill's backlog sections at docs/claude/work/PIPELINE.jsonl + MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json, re-anchor the window on the newest file under comms/reviews/health/, and add `could_not_look` to the template enum -- registering the three-way contract in collapsed-state-guard's CONTRACTS table is the mechanical form. [!] FIXED 2026-09-22 BY THIS LANE, and the GATE IS KEPT RATHER THAN REMOVED -- a review that leaves open items unlooked-at has still not done its job, and that reasoning did not expire with the file. What changed is only WHERE the open set lives. [!] THE BREAK IS WIDER THAN THE ROW SUSPECTED AND IT IS MEASURED, not inferred. `ls docs/claude/*-review-backlog.json` 2026-09-22: ALL FOUR are absent -- health-review-backlog.json, performance-review-backlog.json, research-review-backlog.json, ml-review-backlog.json. So this is not a health-review problem found first; it is ONE break with FOUR instances. /performance-review and /ml-review carry the IDENTICAL 'HARD COMPLETION GATE (not a sample)' heading and the IDENTICAL backlog_coverage.count_untriaged == 0 output contract over files that are not there. THEIR GATES ARE STILL BROKEN and are NOT fixed here -- recorded deliberately, because each is its own skill with its own output template and its own owned surfaces, and repointing all three would be one PR to three concerns. The fix for each is mechanically the same edit; a new table in the health-review skill names them so a session running either sibling meets the fact instead of re-deriving it. [!] WHAT LANDED, in .claude/skills/health-review/SKILL.md (7 stale refs -> 2, and both survivors are deliberate historical citations that SAY the file is gone): (1) THE WINDOW ANCHOR now reads the newest file under comms/reviews/health/ -- the directory this skill's own output lands in, so it is written by this review and by nothing else, with a fallback to the channel ping and then 24h. ⚠️ Recorded beside it: `git log` of the ARCHIVE is history, not an anchor -- it stopped moving when the file was archived, so it would pin the window open forever. That is the trap a later session would otherwise reach for. (2) THE GATE now computes its open set as a COUNTED UNION of two live surfaces: PIPELINE.jsonl (`python3 scripts/ops/pipeline.py --due`, because DUE IS COMPUTED and must not be hand-picked) and the MANAGER-CHECKLIST rows this review OWNS. Write-back routes each item to the surface it came from, with pipeline closes needing a terminal_reason and `killed` named as a first-class outcome. (3) THE OUTPUT CONTRACT now requires backlog_coverage to NAME ITS SOURCES and per-surface counts. `open_at_start: 0` over an unstated population is the same collapsed state one level up -- 'there was nothing open' and 'I could not read the open set' are opposite findings -- and an unreadable surface reports could_not_look WITHOUT shrinking the denominator. (4) The frontmatter description, the step-13 checklist line, and the three FILING destinations (compliance-audit drift, artifact-validity findings, orphan-trade findings) now point at PIPELINE.jsonl VIA scripts/ops/pipeline.py, with 'never by hand' stated -- the script enforces due_when + origin.rerun + an explicit intent=, and the file is append-only JSONL, never a JSON array. [!] ⚠️ THE ARCHIVED BACKLOG IS NOT RESURRECTED and the skill now says so in terms, with the second half the row did not state: the 1,065 archived rows are ALSO NOT IMPORTED (that is A8, and most should be KILLED explicitly rather than carried), so the new denominator is the LIVE open set and not the historical one -- and saying which is part of satisfying the gate. [!] AND THE TEMPLATE HALF IS DONE: comms/schema/health_review_response.template.json now reads `ok | watch | concern | could_not_look` on all 17 findings dimensions, with a _comment_status_enum recording WHY -- the old enum had no value for a dimension that could not be MEASURED, so under a diag outage it FORCED an unmeasurable dimension to render as a measurement outcome. It bit on 2026-09-22 on the mandatory security dimension (0 of 5 sources swept), where the honest answer was none of the three. The comment states that could_not_look is NEVER an all-clear, must name which source was unreachable and why, and is NOT a substitute for `watch` (an unconfirmed signal we DID see). [!] ⚠️ NOT DONE, stated rather than implied: registering the three-way contract in scripts/ci/check_collapsed_states.py's CONTRACTS table -- the MECHANICAL form this row's own proposed fix names. The enum is now WRITABLE but nothing FAILS a review that never emits could_not_look, and per the canonical rules a state nothing branches on is already collapsed. That is the residue and it is the next unit of work on this row.
